review_batches.context: Revios/Geel discuss withholding reinforcements and elector cities; Growster/Lyle discuss victory, the kidnapping and the Liebhofen. All 218 physical rows examined, with later corpus context for elector-city selection rights.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve two companies, secret agreements without inventing parties in this speech, Geel's concealed initiative, over-a-hundred-year age reference, Ymir's prospective Matriarch role and once-in-a-century reputation. Keep threatened blame/ousting as political claims. One source row per English row; all interruptions and source continuations remain intentional fragments.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o000a5.l01: Elector cities have council-selection rights, confirmed by later source scenario.s_086.o02e10.l02 and its parallel s_0c4 occurrence. Do not reduce them to arbitrary selected travel destinations or import an imperial-election system.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o00193.l00: Exactly two companies, not two battalions, divisions or individual mechs.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o00230.l03: Revios knows Geel intends to exploit the opening defeat to control the cities involved in secret pacts. This speech does not name the pact counterpart; keep the wording neutral rather than making Geel the signer.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o002fe.l00: Revios asks why Geel did not consult him, not whether Geel has defected. Preserve the superior/subordinate relationship.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o0042b.l00: Lyle's exaggerated formal congratulations contrast with his usual manner, which Growster immediately notes.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o005e9.l00: Dead weight refers to the head of state, following the earlier daylight-lamp insult localization. Growster plans to pin the kidnapping on that person's unilateral decision.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o0066e.l00: Ymir is regarded as the next Matriarch, not already appointed or installed. Her movement-correction program work and reputation are separate claims.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o006df.l00: This era is an intentional revealing word choice that the adjutant notices. Do not silently replace it with ordinary world or country.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o007d9.l03: Bring down means political removal from power here, not an explicitly ordered physical killing of the whole circle.

review_batches.context: Ymir is held by Solitary Silver Wings; Jono discovers a beacon after a frightening misunderstanding, then proposes marriage. Read all 218 rows, including the guards' discussion and tracking decoys.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve the conditional no-harm promise, restraints, fear, apology, blood-stopping remark, Jono's unsupported lover inference and the unexpected proposal without implying consent. Vales/Vel/Jono spellings follow glossary. No invented physical acts, body detail or medical procedure. Keep every reaction and deliberate unfinished thought.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o0099a.l00: Over a hundred years ago stays imprecise; do not substitute a specific 109-year age for the source's broader statement.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o00aae.l01: Barely scraping by is Vel's joke, contradicted by Jono's literal reply, not a narrator fact that they are starving.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o00bed.l00: Promise of no harm is explicitly conditional on cooperation. Do not turn captivity into an unconditional safety guarantee or a voluntary pleasure trip.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o00c65.l00: Vel volunteers to look after Ymir, but Vales assigns Jono and orders Vel to the cockpit. Keep the rejected offer and actual assignment separate.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o00df9.l01: Ymir recalls the no-harm promise while frightened. Do not invent an assault or sexual act from her fear; later lines reveal the beacon.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o00f10.l00: A tracking beacon is identified, but neither its hiding place nor the exact search/removal action is described in the text.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o00f3d.l01: Her apology and unfinished here gesture lead to the bleeding stopping. No bandage, wound location or treatment technique is supplied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o0102f.l00: Jono explicitly identifies himself as one of her kidnappers/enemies; preserve the coercive context behind the later marriage proposal.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o01197.l00: Jono infers no lover from her refusal to answer. Do not turn that inference into a narrator-confirmed relationship status.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o0121d.l00: Abrupt will-you-be-my-wife proposal, followed by permission to delay an answer. No acceptance or consensual relationship is invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o0134f.l00: Vel makes a nonspecific suggestive joke about the earlier scream. Preserve its unpleasant insinuation without inventing an explicit act or making it true.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o013cf.l00: You're kidding, right reflects Vel's reaction. Do not turn it into a definite I was joking or describe an unshown injury/weapon.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o0144c.l01: Not a stock model identifies custom/nonstandard equipment in context; don't assert a counterfeit brand or a specific factory origin.

review_batches.context: Vel identifies the custom beacon and creates decoys; the party chooses among three routes, then meets flying Zigrim Armored Mechs and waits for an attack. Final 58 rows; all 218 examined.
review_batches.decisions: Keep fictional wavelength jargon provisional, three signatures/routes, time-to-check-all conditional, A/B/C labels and uncertainty of the encampment. Preserve long-distance flying mechs versus transports and the decision to let the opponent strike first. Characters' tactical/legal reasoning is in-world speech, not external legal advice. Source fragments, controls and physical boundaries retained.

row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o0144c.l02: Multi-aspect wavelength format is a provisional rendering of fictional technical jargon. No actual radio frequency, encryption method, number of channels or physical mechanism is inferred.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o014b2.l02: Cannot detect it refers to the Liebhofen on their radar; it is not a statement that the beacon itself emits no signal.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o0150b.l00: Vel exploits the maker's confidence; the next scene shows decoys but does not specify every spoofing step.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o015c4.l01: Exactly three signatures, followed by decoys and three routes. Do not confuse the signal count with three captive Ymirs or three identified enemy ships.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o0167e.l00: The routes are Zigrim's capital, an apparent army encampment and the direction of Limberg. The choices retain A/B/C and the encampment uncertainty.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o0172f.l00: Time to visit all three remains conditional on no mid-route course change. Do not treat it as an unrestricted guarantee.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o017d7.l00: Ai imitates Kasumi's Touya-chan address to tease him. Keep the local honorific echo and his creeped-out response.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o01924.l00: The Armored Mechs themselves fly, not ordinary transports carrying them. Preserve Celica's surprise at long-distance flight.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o019ab.l00: Derock advocates striking first; Touya rejects that course because of the queen's wishes and allied trust. Do not merge these into one shared decision.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o01acc.l01: Ramming is a worst-case hazard, not a collision that has already occurred.
row_decisions.scenario.s_00e.o01b19.l00: Arthur proposes receiving the first blow to establish self-defense in the story. Keep the direction of action and do not replace it with a preemptive strike.
